question: As of 9 October 2026, what do the preserved Unilever records establish about H1 2026 continuing turnover, operating profit and cash flow, and what prevents their use as a price-specific conclusion for the London ordinary share? Retain period, continuing-operation scope and EUR/GBp/GBP distinctions; identify annual-TTM and source-preservation limits.
cutoff_rationale: Exact first versioned baseline commit timestamp: 1b2a859ea438475c4f4d5123beb91fc71b0c19b1 at 2026-10-09T17:02:01+01:00. Earlier project capture times are not reconstructed from as_of fields.
historical_label: Retrospective reconstruction from archived project records; not contemporaneous capture, current investment research or prospective edge evidence.
approval_boundary: Existing company runs, source registers, observations, confirmed lessons and dated study families are authorized artifact families; this does not make their partial/provisional contents approved valuations. Unilever index latest is null; latest_active is r002.
freeze_rules: No route has been run while preparing this protocol. Freeze question, cutoff, bytes, normalized corpus, query, filtering, packet limits and gold before either route runs.
Hold this question/corpus out of implementation tuning and ordinary training/regression fixtures. Implementation tests use separate fixtures.

No outcome-driven changes to query, gold, ranking, cutoffs, source eligibility or packet limits. If a contract cannot be implemented, record failure/limitation; amend only as a new explicitly non-held-out protocol while preserving r001.
Evaluator-only fields polarity and expected_exclusion_reason and all gold/rubric must not enter either route input.
Procedural held-out separation is claimed; evaluator blindness or security isolation is not claimed.
Do not import later research conclusions, engineering review findings or any live source into this frozen comparison.

corpus.source_bytes_are: Exact versioned local project bytes; u1/u2 are selected numerical extracts, not original issuer PDF bytes.
corpus.normalization: Only the explicit frozen records and locations above. No additional sentence splitting, expansion, model summarization or query-specific rewrites.
corpus.note: Metadata validates chronology, structural keys and status; it is not silently injected as passage content.

shared_route_configuration.security_filter: ULVR-London-ordinary-unresolved; retrieval may report unresolved identity, never assert verified listing/order eligibility
shared_route_configuration.truncation: Do not truncate within a passage or table row; omit a whole excess record and record exclusion reason.
shared_route_configuration.prompt_reason: Deterministic retrieval only; no model prompt exists.

eligibility_rules: Check original/frozen byte hash and precise location before indexing or retrieval. Unknown or changed bytes fail closed.

For original-public-source numerical records, publication must be known and no later than cutoff. u2 publication 2026-07-28 is asserted by the preserved source register; u1 publication is unknown and u1-dependent annual/TTM claims are excluded from factual answer passages.

Project analytical/disposition/lesson records must have a verified versioned upper bound no later than cutoff. Preserve actual as_of, creation/capture unknowns and provenance; do not treat as_of as creation date.
The r002 predecessor link supersedes r001 for default current-history retrieval at this historical cutoff. Keep r001 in index/audit with explicit superseded relation; do not erase it.
Admit partial findings only as labelled project-record evidence, including limitations. Do not convert inherited verified-reported labels into a fresh source verification or approval.
Exclude later October14 cost conclusion, wrong-entity APP record and any synthetic future/expired record. Contextual scope must be exact; a broad industry/entity relationship is insufficient.
Return inclusion reason, source id/path/hash/location, dates/status/unknowns and supersession references for each admitted passage. Return exclusions with reason separately, not as answer evidence.

baseline.implementation_status: To implement a deterministic evaluation adapter; no existing general retrieval CLI is claimed.
baseline.basis: Existing file-based research/source register workflow at the named commit; equivalent direct archive inspection restricted to the frozen normalized records.
baseline.algorithm: Apply shared eligibility; casefold text and query phrases, retain a record if any exact query phrase is a substring; rank by descending count of distinct matched phrases then ascending record id; apply shared whole-passage caps.

new.implementation_status: Not implemented or evaluated at freeze.
new.basis: Required derived entity/disposition/claim index from the same frozen records and metadata.
new.fts_query: turnover OR "operating profit" OR CFO OR GBp OR GBP OR EUR OR partial OR missing OR "Ice Cream" OR withheld OR source
new.ranking: bm25 ascending then record id ascending; apply the identical shared eligibility before caps.

gold.meaning: Retrieve both comparable continuing H1 periods with EUR million units and locations. These are preserved project extracts, not reverified originals.

required_exact_passages: H1 IFRS operating profit was EUR4,885m, giving a 19.1% reported operating margin.
Underlying measures, currency-neutral growth and reported turnover must remain separately labelled.
total CFO also contains discontinued cash flow.
gold.meaning: Retrieve reported measure and limitation together; do not replace reported margin with underlying margin or equate continuing and total CFO.

required_exact_passages: A London ordinary-share quote in GBp must first be divided by 100 to obtain GBP.
neither number is a market observation or forecast.
gold.meaning: The illustrative 4,500/1.20 values must stay controlled-test examples, never market observations.

required_exact_passages: Price and FX absent; security valuation and prospective returns withheld.
gold.meaning: Focused reviewed limitations do not become full-thesis or security acceptance.

Verified numerical extracts and precise links retained; complete PDFs remain online.
gold.meaning: Do not claim original PDFs or complete table/footnote access.

table_contract.footnote_limit: Full original footnotes are unavailable; retain the project narrative as attributed and do not certify complete extraction.

rubric.scoring: Boolean per gold/control/dimension, with pass count and explicit failures. No percentage-quality, profit-confidence, edge or savings score.
pass_conditions: All five gold items are returned with every exact supporting/contrary substring and correct source references.
The complete six-row table and normalized field labels survive without original-header claims, period/unit loss or invented footnotes.
All six historical negative controls are correctly excluded and labelled; excluded evidence cannot enter factual conclusions.
Every admitted passage has a specific inclusion reason and intact source path/hash/location, chronology and review status.
Packets respect both bounds without truncating atomic passages; exclusions are explicit.
Separate synthetic controls are detected as specified; these results cannot improve historical recall scores.
Rebuilding the new index from identical source bytes yields identical selected records, packet content hash and exclusion decisions.
Both routes make zero worker and network calls; absent tokens/costs remain unavailable, not estimated.
rubric.comparison_rule: Report each route independently. Equality is a legitimate result. An efficiency gain is reportable only if new-route quality meets all primary rubric items with no regression; never claim prefix-cache or percentage savings. A defect is an implementation failure to repair without altering the frozen gold.

known_limitations: Small single historical case; no statistical generalization or trading-edge conclusion.
Only selected numerical extracts exist; complete issuer table headers/footnotes and primary PDF bytes cannot be evaluated or claimed preserved.
u1 public date unknown: strict cutoff withholds annual TTM facts even though project narrative contains them.
Historical Unilever analytical approval is partial; latest is null and current price, FX and security/order verification are absent.
Original creation/capture timestamps are often missing; first versioned commit supplies upper bounds, not contemporaneous collection.
No real route outputs or performance results exist at freeze.
No new research conclusion, source approval, external source re-verification or live gate satisfaction is created by this protocol.
